description:
ISHA’s debut album ‘Feel At Home’ follows the 25-year-old female producer, multi-instrumentalist, bass player’s journey into her next phase as a singer-songwriter. Stepping away from collaborative studio sessions and diving deeper into her own personal story the album relays ISHA’s journey with shifts in personal relations, role patterns & dynamics with those in one’s inner circle and how they consistently move and change. The indie-jazz debut album captures the artists’ reflections of internal struggles and change eventually bringing around of feeling at home. 

As Netherlands' first queer producer, bassist, and multi-instrumentalist to have played Montreux Jazz Residency ISHA previously played support for acts like Franc Moody, YIN YIN, Adi Oasis & Marcus Miller across international stages with a two-piece-set-up. She played stages like London Jazz Festival, Brick Lane Jazz, Eurosonic to The Great Escape and received support from key tastemakers like BBC Radio 6, Jazz FM, KEXP, RTBF Jam, FIP Radio and BBC 1Xtra.
